text:
Evan: Short exec pulse for leaders this week. Four quick items: (1) Private GA checklist status, (2) incident recap + immediate mitigations, (3) a small retention policy change for debug logs, and (4) Q2 cost gap and next steps. Read and act where assigned.

Sophie: Can you confirm the Private GA hold points? I need to plan comms with Customer Success.

Evan: Key holds: security attestation from Vendor Z, final e-sign for MSA, and a runbook verification for on-prem install. We have two of three done; Vendor Z ETA Wed. No external comms until all three are green.

Diego: On the incident 11: root cause was overload during burst causing the autoscaler to thrash worker groups. Hotfix v2.3.1 deployed removed the immediate race. Mitigations: add a 30s cooldown before deletion, deterministic ordering, and a post-deploy load test. I've created INC-2026-211 in JIRA with owner tags.

Claire: For canary timing - propose tomorrow 09:00 PT for 10% traffic. If metrics stable after 45m we move to 50%. SRE will be on rotation.

Evan: Claire, please run the fallback test and share results. Also freeze non-essential UI pushes during the window.

Claire: Fallback test: `./infra/canary_check.sh --threshold 0.5` passed locally. I'll run on staging tonight and report.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: canary/autoscaler-v2.3.1 -> prod-canary at 2026-03-24T09:00:05Z

Diego: I've added temporary alerts on /dashboards/autoscaler and /dashboards/latency. Tail latency and error-rate alerts are live.

Evan: Incident summary for execs (one-liner for forwarding): "A transient autoscaler race caused latency spikes for a fraction of dedicated capacity customers. Hotfix v2.3.1 mitigated the issue; long-term fixes and canary rollout are in progress. No customer data exposure detected. We'll notify impacted customers under SLA follow-up."

Sophie: Policy tweak: Hosted API debug-log retention default shortened from 90 to 60 days for non-PII to reduce storage spend. Security approved; docs update scheduled and Console banner planned.

Evan: Cost update: infra + Optimize changes project ~6% unit-cost reduction this quarter; still short of the 10% Q2 target. Ops/Infra please prioritize the Optimize backlog caching and batching tickets.

Claire: I'll reprioritize two caching PRs and delay one experiment to make room.

Diego: Postmortem tasks assigned in INC-2026-211. I'll track completion and post daily status in #eng-oncall.

Evan: Action owners: Claire (canary + rollback), Diego (postmortem + alerts), Sophie (attestations + comms), Ops/Finance (costs). I'll close the loop Friday in the exec sync. Ping me directly if anything escalates. :eyes:

Claire: Canary completed: prod-canary success at 2026-03-24T09:06:12Z. Monitoring at +30m: green.

Sophie: Vendor Z attestation received; moving off hold. Will coordinate comms with CS tomorrow morning.

Diego: All postmortem remediation tickets created and owners assigned. Status updates will be posted daily.

Evan: Thanks all 14 keep comms concise if we need to escalate to customers. Appreciated. :white_check_mark:
